nia (mktg): quick flag for tomorrow's KPI huddle  live dashboard shows 431 launch-post leads but HubSpot has 298 tagged. need reconciliation before the exec slide :eyes:
omar (analytics): likely mix of counting (event rows) vs contact dedupe + attribution window differences. also noticed a cluster of linkedin referrals with missing utm params

trent (revops): confirmed ~44 events were backfilled due to a webhook retry window on 2026-03-12 that completed after HS daily sync. those won't be tag-matched unless reconciled manually
harper (sales): sales pipeline shows ~281 records in period. 4 high-ARR leads got routed to enterprise and lost the campaign tag in handoff, flagging as quality-impact examples
nia (mktg): proposed immediate actions: 1) omar run distinct-email dedupe for 3/8-3/15 2) trent export backfill IDs and timestamps 3) leigh add inferred-linkedin row to dash (non-authoritative) 4) harper check owners for top enterprise leads
omar (analytics): running quick SQL now:
```sql
select campaign_label, count(distinct lower(email)) as unique_contacts
from (
  select email,
    case when utm_campaign is null and referrer ilike '%linkedin%' then 'inferred-linkedin'
         else coalesce(utm_campaign,'no-utmc') end as campaign_label
  from events.leads
  where received_at between '2026-03-08' and '2026-03-15'
) t
group by campaign_label
order by unique_contacts desc;
```
results in ~3m
